question.text: What will be the highest score achieved by any model on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index on December 31, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria:
This question will resolve to the highest Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score (to the nearest integer) displayed on the [Artificial Analysis LLM leaderboard](https://artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models) on December 31, 2026, when accessed by a Metaculus administrator. 

All models listed on the leaderboard with a published Intelligence Index score will be eligible.

# Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: research brief for the Dec 31, 2026 top-score question

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-08: When I fetched the AA leaderboard today, the top scores were Gemini 4 Carbon (high) 60, Claude Opus 5.5 (max) 59, Gemini 4 Carbon (medium) 58, Claude Opus 5.5 (xhigh) 57 and GPT-6 Astra (max) 57. Places 6 to 9 (GPT-6 Astra xhigh and high, GPT-6.1 Sol max, Claude Sonnet 5.5 max) are all 55. [leaderboard](https://artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models)
- 2026-11-08: The index page is labelled v5.0.1 and shows only whole numbers, so I found no decimals. It has nine evaluations in four pillars weighted 25% each (knowledge work, coding, science, general). [AA index](https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/artificial-analysis-intelligence-index)
- The question background says Carbon scored 59 as of Oct 31. The live page now shows 60, probably because of the v5.0.1 regrade (see below).

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The top displayed score is 60, from Gemini 4 Carbon (high), and Opus 5.5 (max) is 1 point behind.
- 2026-11-03: v5.0.1 regraded every model on CritPt v2. [changelog](https://artificialanalysis.ai/changelog) Coverage of the v5 launch had Carbon at 59 and Opus 5.5 at 58. [tbreak](https://tbreak.com/gemini-4-carbon-artificial-analysis-claude-opus-5-5/), [byteherald](https://www.byteherald.com/2026/11/how-intelligence-index-v5-rewrote-ai.html?m=1) The changelog, however, records Carbon (High) entering at 60 on Oct 28.
- The biggest structural risk: the fine print applies whatever index version is in effect on Dec 31. New versions have often pushed absolute scores down.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-05: Inkling 2 Small (Thinking Machines) scored 31. [changelog](https://artificialanalysis.ai/changelog), [officechai](https://officechai.com/ai/thinking-machines-releases-inkling-2-small-to-become-top-scoring-non-chinese-model-on-artificial-analysis-intelligence-index-once-weights-release/)
- 2026-11-04: Muse Wonder (High) scored 41 and Tencent Hy4 scored 35. [changelog](https://artificialanalysis.ai/changelog)
- 2026-11-01/02: Gemini 4 Carbon (Medium) scored 58 and Carbon (Low) scored 54. [changelog](https://artificialanalysis.ai/changelog)
- 2026-10-28: Gemini 4 Carbon launched with access limited to vetted cyber defenders and no general-access date. It is listed as #1 at 60. [changelog](https://artificialanalysis.ai/changelog), [tbreak](https://tbreak.com/gemini-4-carbon-artificial-analysis-claude-opus-5-5/)
- 2026-10-27: AA launched Intelligence Index v5. It added FrontierCode 2.0 and Terminal-Bench-Science, swapped in HLE-Diamond, and removed AA-LCR, SciCode and GDPval-AA. About 60% of the index now uses private test sets. Opus 5.5 (max) led at launch with 58. [changelog](https://artificialanalysis.ai/changelog), [cellcog](https://cellcog.ai/blog/artificial-analysis-intelligence-index-v5/)
- 2026-10-26: GPT-6.1 Terra launched, topping out at 51 (Max). [changelog](https://artificialanalysis.ai/changelog)
- 2026-10-20: The Information reported that Anthropic is readying a new model, with no name or date. This rests on a single source. [explainx](https://explainx.ai/blog/anthropic-new-model-gemini-4-carbon-openai-terra-the-information-report-what-we-know-2026) Opus 6 rumours are based on routing sightings and remain unconfirmed. [cellcog](https://cellcog.ai/blog/claude-opus-5-6-release-date/)
- I found no confirmed frontier release for Nov to Dec 2026. CNBC reported that OpenAI shelved a model on safety grounds. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/02/tech-download-google-argon-frontier-openai-anthropic.html)

## 4. Base rates
- The index is revised often: v4.0 in Jan 2026, v4.1 on Jun 16, then v4.1.1, v4.2, v4.3 (up to v4.3.2), v5.0 on Oct 27 and v5.0.1 on Nov 3. That is about 6 or more versions in about 10 months, so a new version (major or minor) before Dec 31 is plausible. [v4 X post](https://x.com/ArtificialAnlys/status/2008570646897573931), [v4.1](https://artificialanalysis.ai/articles/artificial-analysis-intelligence-index-v4-1), [changelog](https://artificialanalysis.ai/changelog)
- Top score by version, according to one explainer: about 66 under v4.1 (Claude Fable 5.1 max), 57 under v4.2 and 53 under v4.3, the last rising to about 58 by October. Version changes have cut the top score by 5 to 9 points. [capitalandcompute](https://capitalandcompute.net/ai-benchmarks/artificial-analysis-intelligence-index/)
- Within a single version, the top score moves slowly to moderately:
  - Under v4.1 it was 60 from Jun 9 to Jul 17 (Fable 5). [AA article](https://artificialanalysis.ai/articles/four-frontier-launches-in-eight-days-six-labs-now-field-a-model-above-50-on-the-artificial-analysis-intelligence-index)
  - Under v4.3 it went from 53 to about 58 over a few months.
  - On 2026-10-23 the Manifold creator recorded Opus 5.5 (max) at 57.6, then Carbon took it to 60 under v5. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-any-ai-model-score-60-on-the-a)
- A single frontier launch has typically added 1 to 3 points to the top score. Bigger jumps have come only with new model generations.
- Seasonality: not applicable, and the series is too short to compare the same weeks across years.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi, "AI scores above 65 on the AA index" (fetched 2026-11-08): before Dec 1, 14%; before Jan 1, 2027, 32%; before Feb 1, 53%; before Apr 1, 69%. I could not check the strict versus inclusive threshold wording because the page returned HTTP 429. This market asks whether 65 is ever crossed, not what the score is on Dec 31.
- Kalshi, "Top AI model this month" (Nov 30): Gemini 4 Carbon (High) 72%, gemini-4-argon-high 12%, claude-opus-5.5-high 2%.
- Manifold, "60+ by Nov 20, 2026": 86%. The leaderboard already shows 60, so this looks effectively met. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-any-ai-model-score-60-on-the-a)
- Manifold, "Open-weights model #1 in 2026": 10%. The best open-weights model, Kimi K3.1 Pro, is at 46.
- I found no market that matches this question's integer value on Dec 31.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- A possible new Anthropic flagship (the unconfirmed Information report and Opus 6 rumours). Opus 5.5 is only 1 point behind Carbon.
- A possible OpenAI successor to GPT-6 Astra. No date has been announced.
- A wider Gemini 4 Carbon rollout or a higher reasoning tier above "high". Not announced.
- Possible AA index revisions (v5.1 or other patches) that could rescale scores either way. These have historically come every 1 to 2 months.
- Live measurement drift: AA says leaderboard metrics are based on the past 72 hours of measurements. That clearly applies to speed and price figures. I did not confirm whether Intelligence scores also move with it.
- The question resolves from the page a Metaculus admin sees on 2026-12-31.

- Seasonality: no meaningful seasonal cycle. The index is only a few weeks old in its current version, so there are no earlier years to compare.

- I found no expert forecasts of the exact year-end value.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Possible releases: GPT-6.5 or another OpenAI frontier model (rumored but undated), Claude Opus 6 or Fable 5.2 (rumored), Gemini 4 Carbon general availability or a "max/deep think" variant (the medium-to-high gap is already 2 points), and Grok 4.8 or Grok 5.

- Risks to watch for: a model being delisted, or "default fallback" configurations being reclassified.
